ideas.idea: Add robots.txt disallows for other training crawlers (CCBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, etc.) to enforce trainingCrawlers: block
ideas.why: The config says block training crawlers but robots.txt only blocks GPTBot, so the wildcard allows the rest.

ideas.idea: Add explicit Allow entries for AI search crawlers (OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, etc.)
ideas.why: The wildcard already allows them, so explicit entries have very little effect.

ideas.idea: Remove the Bingbot block because it contradicts aiSearchCrawlers allow (the claim that ChatGPT search, Copilot and DuckDuckGo depend on Bing's index)
ideas.why: This restates the known Bingbot problem.

ideas.idea: Use a Remix loader instead of useEffect for changelog entries, and confirm /api/changelog exists
ideas.why: This is the known changelog client-rendering problem; the loader fix is part of it.

ideas.idea: Publish plan names and prices as real text on the pricing page
ideas.why: pricing.tsx only says 'Talk to us for a quote', so there are no facts for people or AI answers to cite.

ideas.idea: Add Offer/Product JSON-LD to pricing page
ideas.why: JSON-LD is explicitly not a required fix, and this is a deliberate choice.
Having no JSON-LD is a deliberate choice, and FAQPage leans on the mandatory-FAQ folklore.

ideas.idea: Improve root meta: more specific title and add og:/twitter: tags and a canonical link
ideas.why: This is accurate, but social tags are standard advice for any site, and the root canonical would be the same on every route.

ideas.idea: Add concrete content to the home and features pages: named integrations and feature descriptions
ideas.why: The home page says 'all the tools you already use' without naming any, and features is one sentence.

ideas.idea: Add a short FAQ or 'what is Atlas' paragraph
ideas.why: A 'what is Atlas' paragraph is fine, but the FAQ part is the mandatory-FAQ folklore and it adds little here.

ideas.idea: Replace the div onClick with a Link and add Features to the nav
ideas.why: This is a concrete fix, since the nav in root.tsx lacks Features and the home page link is a div.
It is accurate, but it is covered by replacing the div with a real link and is a standard accessibility point.
A standard accessibility tweak with little effect on discoverability.
This is accurate but has a small effect on a four-URL site.

ideas.idea: Add a favicon via links in root.tsx
ideas.why: This is standard advice that applies to any site.
Having no llms.txt is not a problem, and recommending it as a way to be found is folklore.
This relies on length-count folklore, and the existing descriptions are adequate.

ideas.idea: Keep only one of noindex or robots.txt Disallow for /dashboard, preferring noindex alone
ideas.why: The report's own caveat is true in general, but it reverses the deliberate choice to noindex and disallow /dashboard.
